evidence: Preserves the original x0/x1, calls f_7000d21014, then initializes fields in the object at original x0: writes 0xffffffff00000000 at +0x80, UINT32_MAX at +0x88, zeros at +0x38/+0x50/+0x68/+0x8c/+0x8e/+0xa4/+0xac/+0xb4, writes the table address 0x70021cf030 at +0, and writes UINT32_MAX sentinels at +0xa0/+0xc8/+0x90..+0x98 and +0xb8..+0xc0. It then tail-calls the indexed find_property_map_u32 helper with the original object and x1. decompiled/main/main_0090.c:2702-2736; caller f_7000d25f90 at main_0090.c:6406. The meanings/types of the initialized fields and the first helper are unresolved.

Initializes the output word to 0. Resolves a context pointer from global 0x700227f000+0x620 and offset 0x1b0a8; null exits with zero. Requires attribute-context selector 0x13 low byte == 4, then obtains a float-like value through f_7001877f1c(global 0x7002b26880+0x880); the -1.0 sentinel exits with zero. It compares that value with the signed 16-bit value at resolved-context+0x130 and writes 1 only when they differ. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:51778-51815. Helper/global meanings remain unresolved; no indexed or direct C caller was found.

Reads a pointer from global 0x7003aeb000+0x730. If nonnull, compares the two 64-bit values at pointer+8 and pointer+16. When they are equal, calls f_7000d25780 and writes byte 1 at input+0x404. Separately, when attribute-context status selector 0x13 equals 4, calls f_7000497820 and stores its low byte at input+0x402; the +0x402 update also occurs when the global pointer is null or the two values differ. decompiled/main/main_0036.c:16208-16246. The helper/global meanings remain unresolved; no indexed or direct C caller was found.

Initializes the supplied output word to float sentinel -1.0. The enable test loads a pointer from [0x7003b25000+0x460], reads the dword at pointer+0x26584, and exits with -1 unless all bits in mask 0x22000000 are set ((word & 0x22000000)==0x22000000). When the mask is set, resolves the provider from global context slot 0x700227d000+0xda0 (calling f_700183f6e4 when provider+8 is null), calls accepted player_attribute_get_float with selector 0x54, and stores the returned float bits to output. decompiled/main/main_0124.c:55294-55331. The purpose of the mask and global fields is unresolved; no indexed or direct C caller was found.

Initializes the output word to zero, queries attribute-context status selector 0x13 and proceeds only when its low byte equals 4. It reads a 32-bit input code: 0 calls f_70003feea4, 1 calls f_70003feef0, and 2 calls f_70003fef3c; other values leave the output zero. For the three dispatched codes, stores the called helper result low bit as the output flag. decompiled/main/main_0125.c:47111-47145. The helper meanings remain unresolved; no indexed or direct C caller was found.
